prompt: A left hand in a slim, close-fitting dark brown leather shooting glove, seen alone, first-person game viewmodel. The palm faces up and the fingers curl gently up and around an invisible wooden shotgun forend about 5 cm wide, cradling it from below; the thumb lies along the near side. Thin supple leather with fine seams and knuckle creases, a snug wrist strap. Above the glove an olive green hunting jacket sleeve, long, reaching to mid forearm, ending in a soft open cuff. Realistic proportions, an adult hand, not bulky, not a cartoon. One solid part. No gun, no object in the hand, no text or logo. Realistic materials, neutral even lighting, no background.
